items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 27 at 12:16AM EDT until September 27 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...One to two feet of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...Coastal Pender, Coastal New Hanover and Coastal
Brunswick Counties.

* WHEN...From 6 AM to 11 AM EDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low-lying roads and locations along the Intracoastal
Waterway and adjacent tidal creeks may observe minor coastal
flooding. Check with local officials for any road closures or
impacts.
items.instruction:
Do not drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property.
